name: data.world
tagline: Collaborative open data platform with REST API for datasets, queries, and files
description: data.world is a collaborative data catalog and analytics platform where organizations and communities publish, discover, and query datasets. Its REST API lets developers manage datasets and projects, download files, run SQL/SPARQL queries, and integrate open and private data into applications and pipelines.

auth.details: Bearer token (API token) via Authorization header; create tokens in account settings after free signup

use_cases: download a file from a dataset
